original_test_intent: Verify ECRC transmit and receive fault handling for every required PCIe slot, including the specified immediate reset for each direction, attributable durable error evidence, successful reboot and restored NIC/link health.
original_method: Reconcile correctable Criteria with mandatory reset and prove pcieerror errortype 2/3 direction semantics; map every physical slot/NIC to NBIO/core/port; decode severity/DPC/SyncFlood policy; establish isolated traffic and durable OOB capture; inject TX once, recover and archive evidence fully, then independently inject RX; timestamp reset/firmware/boot, correlate ECRC source and direction, verify NIC/link/traffic health and restore all state.
manual_activity: The FAE resolves severity/reset semantics, maps the NIC path, performs TX and RX as two separately approved recovery cycles under OOB console and restores the system after each.
required_inputs: Vendor proof for pcieerror errortype 2/3 TX/RX semantics and relation to errortype 2 in einjbiopcie
Decision whether each ECRC is correctable, fatal, or intentionally reset-producing and why
Physical slot/NIC/BDF to socket/die/NBIO/core/port map for all targets
Decoded 7EF6030, masks, DPC, Reset After Sync-Flood and SyncFlood policy
Durable AER/BMC/UEFI source/severity evidence and reset/firmware/boot/link recovery deadlines
Supported OS, traffic isolation, aborts, OOB recovery and exact restoration
safety_requirements: Dedicated backed-up SUT with independent BMC/console and known-good boot/reimage path
Quiesce traffic and exclude boot/management-critical NICs unless recovery is explicitly approved
Validate live tuple and archive durable baseline before each single-direction injection
Complete recovery and evidence closure after TX before separately authorizing RX; abort on boot loop, wrong source or link loss
No automatic retry/reset; preserve crash evidence and restore/diff BIOS/HDT/AER/DPC/SyncFlood state
agent_execution_scope: Validate flag semantics, topology, severity/reset matrix, durable evidence and recovery plan
Collect read-only PCIe/AER, OOB console, BMC/UEFI, reset/boot, link/device/traffic and post-health evidence
Do not install NIC, choose tuple/outcome, change BIOS/HDT, inject/reset/rebind/retry/recover or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve mapped target and separate TX/RX recovery cycles
Supervise injections, boots and NIC recovery

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A live generic grep cannot bridge an immediate reset or distinguish TX/RX ECRC and mixes unrelated error classes.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After semantics and tuple approval, execute TX and RX as separate OOB-captured reset cycles and correlate durable ECRC AER source/direction through clean reboot and link recovery.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Tuple 0:0:1/core3/port0, errortype 2/3, immediate resets, correctable Criteria, severity/SyncFlood settings, slot 1~N and 30/60-minute values remain preserved as conflicting facts.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Run separately authorized TX and RX ECRC reset cycles on a mapped NIC, using durable OOB evidence to prove source/direction and complete boot/link recovery after each.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds command-mode reconciliation, severity/reset decision, durable evidence, per-cycle isolation, deadlines and rollback.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Post-boot dmesg alone cannot prove which direction caused reset or preserve pre-reset AER state.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Either cycle can lose the boot or management path, corrupt active traffic, enter a reboot loop or leave the NIC/link unavailable.

project_override_considerations: If platform policy does not require reset for the approved ECRC severity, do not force a reset merely to match prose; retain the contradiction for owner correction. TX evidence must be closed before RX begins.
expected_evidence: Vendor direction mapping and approved severity/reset matrix with decoded policy
Separate TX transcript plus durable AER/BMC/UEFI and reset/boot timeline
Fully recovered link/device/traffic state before RX authorization
Separate RX durable evidence and second complete recovery

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Criteria call the errors correctable while both procedures require immediate reset. Errortype 2/3 direction and severity are uncited and overlap different semantics in rows 59/60; slot 1~N uses one tuple; durable pre-reset evidence and deadlines are absent; 7EF6030 is undecoded, timeout undefined and RHEL 2022 ambiguous.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Directional ECRC and two-reset intent can be statically reviewed. Actual execution is gated on authoritative severity/reset semantics and recovery authority.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row 63 Wistron-System RAS-00783-V002: prove pcieerror errortype 2/3 TX/RX semantics and reconcile their use with einjbiopcie errortype 2; decide correctable Criteria versus mandatory immediate reset; provide slot/NIC-to-NBIO/core/port coverage; approve 7EF6030/masks/DPC/SyncFlood policy, durable ECRC source/severity evidence, separate TX/RX reset/boot/link deadlines, supported OS, aborts, OOB recovery and restoration.

review_improvement: Converts two loosely described resets into independently gated, durable and direction-attributable recovery cycles and exposes the unresolved correctable-versus-reset contradiction.
independent_technical_reasoning: Immediate reset destroys volatile context, so evidence must be captured by firmware/BMC or OOB console before relying on post-boot logs. TX and RX cannot be run as one sequence unless the first boot and link state are fully restored, or the second result inherits an unknown fault state. The reuse of errortype 2 in another command family means numeric equality alone cannot establish identical ECRC severity semantics.
